name: Breathing Room
description: Shows where your own week has room to breathe and where it does not, from your calendar and what you send: meeting density, back-to-back runs, deep-work blocks, evenings and weekends, and the load already building three to ten days out. When a day or a coming week is overloaded it points to the most movable meetings, and it recognises time off rather than reading it as a quiet week. Reports on you only, never on anyone else.
author: Allan De Castro
coverImageAlt: Dark slate schedule blocks part to reveal a cyan-lit open passage.
